$comment: All five settings below are legacy policies that Microsoft documents as NOT applicable
to Windows 11 and liable to removal. See the correction at the top of the README.
On Windows 11 they may be delivered into the registry and still do nothing: delivered
and honoured are different claims, which is exactly what this tool exists to separate.
Device-side policy values you expect to find under
after your Intune notification profile has applied.
For Windows 11, compare against your deadline settings instead - the ConfigureDeadline*
family is not legacy. Adjust the values to match your own profile, then run

$notes.ScheduleImminentRestartWarning: minutes - final warning. 15..60. Default is 15; 60 gives the user a real chance to react
$notes.SetAutoRestartNotificationDisable: 0 = notifications ENABLED. The label is counter-intuitive: 1 disables them
$notes.AutoRestartRequiredNotificationDismissal: 1 = auto dismissal, 2 = USER dismissal. 2 is the setting that matters: the notification does not clear itself, so the user cannot claim in good faith that they were never told
